name: chitchat-app
description: Real-time chat application powered by Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO

scripts.test: node -e "require('./server.js'); setTimeout(async()=>{ const io=require('socket.io-client'); const s1=io('http://localhost:8000'), s2=io('http://localhost:8000'); await new Promise(r=>s1.on('connect',r)); await new Promise(r=>s2.on('connect',r)); s1.emit('new-user-joined','User1'); s2.emit('new-user-joined','User2'); s2.on('receive-file', (f)=>{ console.log('E2E Test Passed: File received successfully!'); process.exit(0); }); setTimeout(()=>s1.emit('send-file', {name:'test.txt', type:'text/plain', size:12, data:'data:text/plain;base64,SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=', caption:'test'}), 300); }, 1000);"
